stats.notes: No Common Data Set found on mercyhurst.edu (2 searches, no Common Data Set page). Exact counts are from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2024 first-time degree-seeking: 3,567 applied, 2,890 admitted = 81%, 588 enrolled), matching College Navigator's 3,567 applicants and 81% admitted. IPEDS does not split international applicants, so international applicant and admit counts are not available. SAT/ACT scores are not reported to IPEDS (test-optional), so no percentiles.
